thread:
Maya: Heads-up — there's a tiny porch concert in Hayes Valley on Saturday at 7pm :guitar: thinking of heading over. Also there's a neighborhood plant swap at 3pm earlier. anyone doing one or both?
Sam: Porch concert for me! live music > soil in my hair :grin:
Jordan: Plant swap straight to my heart. trying to build a shady corner garden. will probably do the swap then swing by the concert if timing works.
Linh: @Maya are dogs allowed at the plant swap? want to bring scrappy.
Maya: @Linh I saw the event page — says "kid & pet friendly" so should be ok. link: https://tiny.community/plantswap
Priya: I'm in for the plant swap. I can bring cuttings of pothos and a couple of echeveria pups :seedling: anyone want succulents?
Sam: If folks do the swap earlier, anyone want to meet after for tacos? there's a spot near the concert that takes reservations.
Jordan: tacos after sounds perfect. also can bring a small label pack for swapped plants (names + care notes)
Linh: I can make a tiny sign with watering cadence. 2x a week for pothos etc.
Priya: Also happy to bring some snack bars in case the swap runs long.
Maya: Sweet. plan: 3pm plant swap meetup, then 6:30 tacos reservation, concert at 7 for whoever can make it. I'll DM people the exact addresses.
Sam: Count me in. @DeployBot can you block a quick reminder for Saturday 1:30pm to confirm plans? :pray:
DeployBot: Reminder scheduled: Saturday 2024-05-18 13:30 — "Plant swap + tacos plan check" (I'll ping the thread)
Jordan: Awesome. if anyone has extra pots looking for new homes, bring 'em.
Priya: Also — if anyone needs a ride from the Mission, I have room for two.
Linh: Yay! see y'all Saturday :partyparrot:
Maya: Cool, adding everyone to the DM. will post exact spot later.
